note: Corrections to phrases of curriculum/japanese/parallel/zh-lessons.yaml (which, with src/data/parallel, is never edited here), applied by scripts/generate-pack-ja.mjs before anything is derived from the phrases. phrases: phrase id -> { tokens: [{ at, t, w | g }] replaces the token at that index; merge: { at, count, t, w } makes count tokens one; words: { oldEntry: newEntry | null } changes the phrase's word list }. writings: word entry -> { text written in a sentence: text the headword writes } for words the headword writes in kana (ねこ) and sentences in kanji (猫): one writing per word, the headword's, in headword and sentences alike (the phrase text follows its tokens).
